headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run. In another Pirates-Guardians matchup, the Guardians took down the Pirates 3-5, with Travis Bazzana leading the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Ryan Helsley being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. Other players on the injured list include Stephen Kolek (right flexor strain), Justin Sterner (right knee chondromalacia), Lourdes Gurriel Jr. (right adductor strain), Jeff Criswell (right shoulder strain), Sal Frelick (right shoulder strain), Oneil Cruz (left hand fourth and fifth metacarpal non-displaced fractures), and Chris Bassitt (low back discomfort).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Chicago Cubs acquiring Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash, while the St. Louis Cardinals acquired Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Robert Hassell III from the Washington Nationals for cash, and the Milwaukee Brewers acquired Lance McCullers Jr. from the Houston Astros.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Guardians in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, handing the Pirates their loss. Travis Bazzana led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 8th homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Down Mets in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies took down the New York Mets 6-1, with Jesús Luzardo earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 2 BB, 2 H. Trea Turner led the offense with 3 H, 1 HR, 1 RBI, and 4 AB.

top_news.title: **Orioles Update Ryan Helsley's Injured List Status**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles right-handed pitcher Ryan Helsley has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. This change in status is effective as of July 19, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. Civale joins the Cubs' roster following the trade.
